text: The rest of the men there said nothing but you could see they were hard hit. They were simple men who knew a lot maybe about digging for gold but were babes in arms when it came to dealing with owlhooters and desperadoes like Pell and Fenton and the rest. 'I guess we'd better hold onto the gold right 2hyar, Nick, said the Sodbuster. The rest of the men there soidl nothing buf you conicl see they were harc! if. They nere simple men who knew a lot about maybe digging.. cligging for gold! buf were bases in arms When if cane tc cleahing nith. Owlhooters and desperadoes lile Pell and Fenton the. Name: Halte Seal
